_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia — 'Form 1 Mathematics II Term 3 Scheme of Work', covering Topics 1.7-1.13 (the syllabus's own numbering; Topics 1.1-1.6 belong to Terms 1-2, not sourced here). The scheme also cites a commercial textbook (Zambia Educational Publishing House, 2024) alongside the CDC syllabus for its assessment/resource suggestions; that citation and a repeated vendor contact footer offering 'editable schemes' have been omitted — this file contains no identifying or promotional information, per this app's standing content policy of crediting only CDC/Ministry of Education. The source PDF's table layout did not extract in strict reading order (rows interleaved across pages); topic/sub-topic/competency groupings below were reconstructed by matching each numbered competency code (1.7.1.1 etc.) to its correct topic based on the code itself and surrounding context, not assumed from extraction order. Week numbers were similarly reconstructed from the scheme's week-range headers (e.g. "1-2", "3-4"), which paced two weeks per topic; the first week of each range is used per sub-topic (the second sub-topic of a pair, where present, takes the following week) — an approximation, not a literal per-row extraction.

subject.name: Mathematics
subject.description: Ordinary Level Secondary Mathematics syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 1.7.1 Introduction to Relations and Functions
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners define relations and represent functions with 90% accuracy.

competencies.description: Define relations and identify their properties

learning_objectives.description: Creating mapping diagrams for relations in pairs (relations: ordered pairs, domain, range)

sub_topics.name: 1.7.2 Functions Notation and Graphs
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners define relations and represent functions with 90% accuracy.

learning_objectives.description: Graphing simple functions (e.g. y = 2x + 1) on graph paper (function definition, notation e.g. f(x), graphs of linear functions)
Group discussions on function properties; solving function value problems (e.g. find f(2))

sub_topics.name: 1.8.1 Trigonometric Ratios
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners define ratios and solve problems with 85% accuracy.

competencies.description: Define sine, cosine, and tangent ratios

learning_objectives.description: Measuring angles and sides of model triangles (trigonometric ratios: sine, cosine, tangent in right-angled triangles)

sub_topics.name: 1.8.2 Angles of Elevation and Depression
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners define ratios and solve problems with 85% accuracy.

competencies.description: Solve problems involving elevation and depression

learning_objectives.description: Solving elevation/depression problems in groups; drawing diagrams for real-world scenarios (e.g. height calculations)

sub_topics.name: 1.9.1 Data Collection and Representation
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners collect, represent, and calculate measures with 90% accuracy.

competencies.description: Collect and represent data using charts

learning_objectives.description: Conducting a class survey in groups (data types: qualitative, quantitative)
Creating bar and pie charts from data

sub_topics.name: 1.9.2 Measures of Central Tendency
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners collect, represent, and calculate measures with 90% accuracy.

learning_objectives.description: Calculating mean, median and mode for datasets, and presenting charts to the class

sub_topics.name: 1.10.1 Basic Probability
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners calculate probabilities and identify sample spaces with 85% accuracy.

learning_objectives.description: Conducting probability experiments (e.g. coin toss) in groups (probability: definition, formula)

sub_topics.name: 1.10.2 Sample Spaces
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners calculate probabilities and identify sample spaces with 85% accuracy.

competencies.description: Identify sample spaces and simple events

learning_objectives.description: Listing sample spaces for simple events; solving probability problems in pairs (e.g. dice, coins)

sub_topics.name: 1.11.1 Angles and Triangles
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners calculate angles and prove congruence/similarity with 85% accuracy.

competencies.description: Identify and calculate angles in triangles

learning_objectives.description: Measuring angles in triangles using protractors (angle types, angle sum in triangles)

sub_topics.name: 1.11.2 Congruence and Similarity
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners calculate angles and prove congruence/similarity with 85% accuracy.

learning_objectives.description: Constructing congruent triangles in pairs (congruence: SSS, SAS, ASA criteria; similarity: properties, ratios)
Group tasks to prove similarity; drawing geometric figures on graph paper

sub_topics.name: 1.12.1 Introduction to Vectors
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners define vectors, perform operations, and calculate areas/perimeters with 85-90% accuracy.

learning_objectives.description: Drawing vectors on graph paper (vectors: notation, magnitude, direction)

sub_topics.name: 1.12.2 Vector Operations
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners define vectors, perform operations, and calculate areas/perimeters with 85-90% accuracy.

learning_objectives.description: Solving vector addition problems in groups

sub_topics.name: 1.13.1 Area and Perimeter
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: learners calculate compound area and perimeter of 2D shapes with 90% accuracy.

competencies.description: Calculate compound area and perimeter of 2D shapes

learning_objectives.description: Measuring and calculating areas/perimeters of shapes (triangles, rectangles, circles)
Field activity: measuring the school compound to calculate areas
